tools.name: diff_impact
tools.description: Impact of a diff between two indexed revisions of one repo (base..head): changed files + symbols, union blast radius (layers + cross-repo fallout), affected endpoints, test suites, and co-change reminders. Replaces per-symbol relate (kind:blast_radius) loops before merging. Defaults: head = session'

tools.name: estimate_scope
tools.description: Pre-flight estimate before graph traversal: coarse count of files a task likely touches and whether it spans layers (common/browser/node/electron-main/...) or repositories. Decides single-file edit vs consulting the graph. Heuristic, from symbol-name + text matches.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects with indexing summaries. Find a project by name or check which exist.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List repositories in a project. Find repository names to scope a query to one repo.

tools.name: list_file_symbols
tools.description: List symbols in one file (name + kind + line bounds). Step 1 of the two-step read: get line bounds, then pass startLine/endLine to source (op:read) for that slice only (~4-15x fewer tokens). For one symbol + signature, use find_node {symbol, filePath}.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Token-efficient repo (or subtree) skeleton: directory tree with each file's classes (methods in parens), functions, and HTTP endpoints, from the graph. Orient before drilling in. Scope with "path", cap with "maxDepth", density:"full" adds properties. view:"architecture" instead returns a module map

tools.name: list_tests_for
tools.description: Test suites and cases whose suite name matches a symbol name (case-insensitive substring). Call before adding tests to see existing coverage and mirror its shape.

tools.name: quick_lookup
tools.description: Fast substring lookup of symbol DEFINITIONS by name: rows {name, kind, filePath, startLine, repositoryName} (displayName only when distinct from name), no ranking, no semantic. tools.name: freshness
tools.description: Returns lastIndexedSha, lastIndexedAt, and the current remote HEAD sha for a repository: detect index drift from remote. Reports what Symvanta knows, not local git. currentRemoteSha is null when no GitHub credential is configured. Echoes the active ref pin (pinnedBranch, pinnedSha).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: source, ref, find_http_route · Private data: locate, relate, source, history, ref, adr, diff_impact, estimate_scope, list_file_symbols, map, freshness, index_health, ask_codebase, reindex_repository, context, bundle · Public sink: index_health, bundle · Destructive: ref, diff_impact, index_health, bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: source, ref, find_http_route · Private data: locate, relate, source, history, ref, adr, diff_impact, estimate_scope, list_file_symbols, map, freshness, index_health, ask_codebase, reindex_repository, context, bundle · Public sink: index_health, bundle · Destructive: ref, diff_impact, index_health, bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
